subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu plugin send message fails with 400 error - receive_id_type is required

question: Should maintainers revive the open conflicting fork PR, close it and allow a narrow replacement repair, or keep waiting for contributor proof?
rationale: The issue is paired with an open cross-repo PR using closing syntax and the issue already has `clawsweeper:no-new-fix-pr`, so automation should not queue a separate repair until maintainers decide what to do with that candidate.

options.title: Close or replace the fork candidate
options.body: Treat the conflicting fork PR as noncanonical, then allow a narrow same-repo fix with live Feishu proof and regression coverage.

options.title: Revive the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author to rebase, fix the prior type/proof gaps, and provide real Feishu/Lark send proof before review resumes.

options.title: Wait for more reporter data
options.body: Keep the issue open without repair work until a current Feishu tenant reproduction confirms the exact failing ID shape and request details.

recommendation.title: Close or replace the fork candidate
recommendation.body: Treat the conflicting fork PR as noncanonical, then allow a narrow same-repo fix with live Feishu proof and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu community maintainer, making them the best available domain owner for the PR-vs-replacement decision.
